# P37.5b — manual-acquisition record/runbook + disappearance events + portal change feed

Manifest row 425 (`R11-DEBT-03`; `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/425_P37.5b__manual-acquisition-and-disappearance-events.md live_verification=false`). The b-half of the split P37.5 row: the two remaining F2a group-10 scope lines — the manual-acquisition record/runbook (SIG-INGEST-008) and disappearances persisted as append-only events + research tasks (SIG-INGEST-009/010, catalog AC `disappeared_observed_at has a writer`) — plus the P37.5a unwired-scan's routed `capability-half` `flock_portal` change-detection findings.

## What changed

- **SIG-INGEST-008 — manual acquisition modelled.** `connectors/manual_acquisition.py` + `data/manual_acquisitions.toml` (`sig.manual-acquisitions/1`): each `[[dependency]]` models one manual dependency (identifier/doi, version, sha256, acquired_at, `pending|acquired`, access path, runbook). `sig-connectors validate` fails closed on either direction of the model rule and on provenance dishonesty (an `acquired` row missing DOI/identifier, version or checksum; a `pending` row carrying acquisition fields = a fabricated record). `sig-connectors run` refuses a registered manual dependency in **every** mode — exit 3 naming `docs/ops/manual-acquisition.md`, the documented human procedure. The build cannot assume fetchability.
- **SIG-INGEST-009/010 — disappearance persistence.** `tasks/disappearance_pg.py` is the `disappeared_observed_at` writer: `persist_disappearance` resolves the artifact (uuid or locator/url), applies the two §17.6 event columns (`capture_status` latest, `disappeared_observed_at` first-observation-wins `COALESCE` — an observation once recorded is never erased), and lands the `research_task` row append-only + idempotent (entity-resolved dedup on `UNIQUE (task_type, subject_id)`; unresolved subjects land subjectless citing `trigger_kind`/`trigger_ref`, deduped SELECT-first). The sqitch `disappearance_event_grant` change grants `sig_ingest` `UPDATE` on **those two columns only** — append-only holds inside the grant (proven on a real engine). `disappeared_artifacts` + `sig-tasks disappearances` is the queryable read.
- **Portal change feed.** `connectors/portal_changes.py` drives the routed `capability-half` functions (`is_poll_due`, `portal_capture`, `diff_portal_snapshots`, `detect_portal_changes`) into the deterministic `sig.portal-changes/1` feed — appearance/disappearance `portal_exists` claims + research tasks + the per-field `FieldChangeEvent` stream (SIG-RECON-045). `sig-tasks portal-changes` emits the report; `--dsn` persists task rows. An undated snapshot emits `observed_at`-absent claims — never wall-clock in a claim value (SIG-INGEST-018; `detect_portal_changes`/`portal_appeared_task` widened to `date | None`, additive).
- **Records.** ADR-234 + ADR_TRIGGERS row + adr-index; COVERAGE_MATRIX `SIG-INGEST-008`/`SIG-INGEST-010` → MET; CHANGELOG; the unwired-scan baseline drops the five now-wired flock_portal rows (99 → 94).

## Requirement ids

Serves SIG-INGEST-008 (manual-acquisition MUST), SIG-INGEST-009/010 (disappearance events + research tasks + queryability), SIG-INGEST-018 (no wall-clock in claim values), SIG-INGEST-030c/035 (upstream-keyed poll due + portal change detection), SIG-EVID-013/014 (§17.6 event columns), SIG-TASK-007 (task dedup). No §56 `Owner:` line names this row.
